processIntro: We agree the vehicle details and creative approach early, then review the work at the moments that matter.

steps.title: Define the brief.

briefIntro: You do not need a complete production pack to begin. Send the essentials, and we will identify the gaps and recommend a practical scope.

inputs.title: The vehicle
inputs.text: Models, market, trims and available CAD or reference images.

inputs.title: The story
inputs.text: Campaign objectives, key features, brand guidance and any creative references.

inputs.title: The channels
inputs.text: Where the content will appear, the formats required and any language versions.

inputs.title: The timing
inputs.text: Your launch date, review team and any fixed milestones.

faqs.q: What if we do not have a 3D CAD file?
faqs.a: We can help. NMESIS has developed a workflow for building detailed vehicle twins from reference images and vehicle information. We first review what is available, identify any missing views or specifications, and agree how the model will be checked for accuracy.

faqs.q: Can one vehicle asset support films, stills and interactive content?
faqs.a: Yes. We plan the digital twin around its intended uses so the same core vehicle asset can support campaign imagery, films, feature animation and interactive experiences. Some outputs may need additional preparation, which we define in the scope.

faqs.q: Can you match the trims sold in our market?
faqs.a: Yes. We work from the agreed local specification, including colours, interiors, wheels, equipment and other visible details. Your team reviews the vehicle before the final content is produced.

faqs.q: Can we commission just one film or key visual?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We can start with a single deliverable or plan a connected launch package. The scope depends on what you need now and whether the assets should also support future content.

faqs.q: How long does production take, and what affects the cost?
faqs.a: The main factors are the number of vehicles, the condition of the available assets, scene complexity, animation, output formats and review rounds. After reviewing the brief, we propose a schedule and quote for the agreed scope.

faqs.q: Can you work with our agency or internal marketing team?
faqs.a: Yes. We can develop the visual direction with you or produce against an established campaign concept. We agree responsibilities, technical requirements and approval stages with your team at the start.

ctaText: Tell us the vehicle, the market and the moment you are planning. We will help shape the right content around it.
